Famous Polish map maker, PLPAK project participant. Created such maps as 'Running Wild', 'Rusted Factory', 'Ika', 'Somewhere in the north', 'One Must Fall' or 'Stormland' among others which are popular mainly on the [[FFA]] servers.
He has also modified numerous of standard maps to make them more playable in [[TDM]] mode (e.g. [[E3M3TDMB]] or [[E3M7TDM]]). He has also converted 2 out of 5 Counter-Strike maps ('Dust2' and [[Mirage map|Mirage]]) to QuakeWorld as part of [[The Wizard's Manse]] project.
